title: Population-Aligned Persona Generation for LLM-based Social Simulation
reasoning: The research incorporates the World Values Survey (WVS) as an evaluation benchmark, which includes specific dimensions for religious beliefs, core values, and ethical views. The framework is explicitly tested on its ability to generate personas that align with these human distributions across different regions, and the prompts used in the case studies specifically instruct the model to ensure personas are sufficient for answering questions on religious and ethical views.
